title: Open-Ended Surveying Services
short_description: Framework-style surveying support services for college facility construction and operations.
project_scope: Selection of up to two surveying firms to provide occasional support for the construction and operation of Rowan-Cabarrus Community College facilities. No specific building, structure, span, floor area, or technical project characteristics are defined in the notice.
services: Open-ended surveying services; requested disciplines listed include architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, environmental engineering/planning/design, structural engineering, utility engineering, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a surveying services procurement, which is not a core target for sbp.
- No defined bridge, special structure, long-span roof, stadium, or complex building project is identified.
- Appears to be an open-ended/on-call service arrangement rather than a specific technically demanding structure.
- Includes many broad disciplines, but no concrete structural engineering scope or planning phases are described.
- Framework-style service contracts without technical specification are generally low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost for a specific project is stated. The notice only gives a contract value of 150000, which appears to relate to the service contract, not construction works. No realistic construction cost estimate is possible because no individual project, size, or technical scope is defined.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee for structural engineering or sbp-relevant services is stated. The only stated amount is a total contract value of 150000 for open-ended services across surveying-related support; this is not a reliable basis for an sbp fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Up to two surveying firms are to be selected for occasional support services. No specific reference counts, project types, fee zones, or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Rowan-Cabarrus Community College, Salisbury, North Carolina, USA. Contact: Ronda Holland. Email: collegeenvironment@rccc.edu. Phone: 704-216-3455. Website: https://evp.nc.gov/solicitations/details/?id=515cf644-4c4a-f111-88b4-001dd812e0a9

Although structural engineering is listed among requested disciplines, the procurement is centered on open-ended surveying support and lacks a defined building or structural project.
